crop.notes: Only the three-line 'Sporting Notes' item at the top of crop-1 is about Allen (a notice for his place). The rest of the clipping is an unrelated reprint, 'The Dog's Origin' from Harper's Young People.

ocr.notes: The Allen notice is transcribed correctly ('Tom ALLEN'); the dog article has minor errors.

title.suggested: Notice of free concerts at Tom Allen's, 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: A notice under "Sporting Notes" in the St. Louis Globe-Democrat advertised Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with free concerts every evening and only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, June 25, 1892, page 7.

facts.fact: In June 1892 Allen's place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertised free concerts every evening; he styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Recurring notice (same text as 805, 919, 854). Focus suggested primary because the item itself is entirely about Allen, though it is only a three-line notice.
